As you can see, the best warriors gather here in Goddard. I've been noticing a number of talented young people like yourself these days. Somethin…

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-01.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: Ha! Are you the successor mentioned by the bride of Antharas ? Of course! She visited me a while back. She said that someone was following her footsteps, seeking the power of the dragon! Can you solve the riddle?

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-05.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: You're back! Did you bring the Divine Stone of Wisdom? Good job! You are as capable as the bride of Antharas told me. Now I'll give you the Stone of Commune. The stone tablet that forms a union with it is north of the Varka Silenos stronghold. I'd like to see it myself, but I…

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-04.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: Have you earned their trust? Go to either the Varka Silenos or the Ketra Orcs to obtain a Divine Stone of Wisdom and bring it to me. Pick either one, it doesn't matter. Change your mind if you choose. Just get it.

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-06.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: Didn't I tell you? Look for the Tablet of Vision!

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-02.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: Go to the Ketra Orcs advance base and meet with Messenger Wahkan! He will tell you how to befriend them. Since you're skilled, I'm sure they'll welcome you. Earn their trust, obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom and return here!

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-03.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: First go to the Varka Silenos stronghold and meet with Naran Ashanuk, Varka's Messenger! He'll tell you how to befriend them. Since you're skilled I'm sure they'll welcome you. Earn their trust, obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom and return here!

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/3-07.htm.text: Grand Master Bernhard: She asked me to keep the Stone of Commune until someone worthy came to me for it. She also says that it's not complete.
